ms.text:
MP1
factor:
valid factor which may affect rate of temperature rise
MP2
apparatus:
thermometer
and
additional apparatus necessary to measure independent variable
MP3
method:
•
measure independent variable
•
measure temperature (change) and / or time appropriate to procedure
•
repeat for new value of independent variable
MP4
control variable:
any significant variable appropriate to independent variable
(e.g. volume of water if current is the independent variable)
MP5
table:
columns, with units, for independent variable and dependent variable
MP6
analysis:
compare readings in the table to see if change in factor produces change in (rate of) temperature rise,
plot (line) graph (with axes specified)
MP7
additional point (one from):
2nd valid control variable stated,
at least 5 sets of data taken,
repeat each measurement and take average,
